description: Web scraping / web page to clean text: any URL rendered in a real browser (JavaScript pages included) and returned as readable text with title, description and links. Use it to read an article, docs page or product page before summarising or extracting. Input: url. Raw status, headers and body: fetch.raw. A question answered from the page: research.brief. $0.10 per call. Returns: title, description, text, text_chars, links[], javascript_rendered.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_extract_page
title: Web page extraction
